+def test_parse_clixml_decodes_escapes():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Error">'
+            b'_x000D_|_x000A_|_x000D__x000A__x0000__x263A__xD83D__xDE00__x005f_ '
+            b'_x005F__x000A_ _x005F_ _x005G_ _x123_'
+            b'</S></Objs>')
+    expected = '\r|\n|\r\n\x00\u263a\U0001f600_ _\n _x005F_ _x005G_ _x123_'.encode('utf-8')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == expected
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_surrogate_pair_across_stream_elements():
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error">_xD83D_</S><S S="Error">_xDE00_</S></Objs>'
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == '\U0001f600'.encode('utf-8')
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_preserves_unpaired_surrogates():
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error">_xD83D_/_xDE00_</S></Objs>'
+    expected = '\ud83d/\ude00'.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == expected
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_joins_stream_text_within_blocks():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Error">first</S><S S="Info">ignored</S>'
+            b'<S S="Error"> second</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Info">ignored</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error">third</S></Objs>')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b'first second\r\nthird'
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_empty_stream_elements():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Error" /><S S="Info">ignored</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error"></S></Objs>')
